---
title: "BCB420 Docker Homework"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
set.seed(42)

m <- matrix(sample(1:100, 50, replace = TRUE), nrow = 5, ncol = 10)

colnames(m) <- c("cond1","cond2","cond3","cond4","cond5",
"ctrl1","ctrl2","ctrl3","ctrl4","ctrl5")

rownames(m) <- paste0("gene", 1:5)

m

cond_mean <- rowMeans(m[, 1:5])
ctrl_mean <- rowMeans(m[, 6:10])

fold_change <- cond_mean / ctrl_mean

data.frame(
gene = rownames(m),
cond_mean = cond_mean,
ctrl_mean = ctrl_mean,
fold_change = fold_change
)
```
